items.title: Novo taps Anthropic’s Claude to ‘supercharge’ R&D efforts
items.summary: Anthropic said it would help Novo shorten research timelines and discover impactful medicines.

items.title: Cellares and GenomeFrontier to assess automated GF-CART01 production
items.summary: Cellares and GenomeFrontier Therapeutics are to assess automated manufacturing for the latter’s investigational CAR-T cell therapy, GF-CART01, on the Cell Shuttle platform.

items.title: Viatris’ Wakix receives Japanese approval to treat OSAS and narcolepsy
items.summary: Japan’s Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare has approved Viatris’ Wakix for EDS related to OSAS and for narcolepsy types 1 and 2.

items.title: Sling ropes in $123m for oral thyroid eye disease drug
items.summary: Sling is racing to market the first oral IGF-1R blocker, which would likely provide competition to Amgen’s Tepezza.

items.title: Looking beyond short-term turmoil, Syngene is investing for the future
items.summary: CRDMO Syngene has revamped its leadership and is building capacity as it eyes growth and emerging modalities.
